candidates.spoken: Why fewer than 100 people remember every day.
What If You Remembered Every Day of Your Life?
After a 2006 study, over 200 people claimed it.
It covers personal life events, not everything they read.
Vivid recall of dates and events.
Each answer must come within 11 seconds.
Testers match dates to 60 famous events.
Only a handful turned out to be genuine.
It would not all happen at once.
Hyperthymesia isn't photographic memory for everything.
In the aftermath of the 2006 Neurocase publication alone.
So forgetting may be as useful as remembering.
